summary: Public projects created on 27 May 2025: 2 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Two prompt collections cover system prompts for AI agents and assistants and text transformation prompts, the latter turning raw speech-to-text transcripts into other formats. A reference dataset holds an up-to-date library of system prompts for AI systems and autonomous agents.

projects.name: System Prompt Library
projects.description: System prompts for AI agents and assistants (automatically populated); periodic point in time exports are releases

projects.name: Text Transformation Prompt Library
projects.description: Updated repo of text transformation prompts (raw STT transcripts -> *). New repo for capturing via automations.

projects.name: System Prompt Library
projects.description: This repository contains a comprehensive, up-to-date library of system prompts for AI systems and autonomous agents, started on May 27th, 2025.
